note: Town campground on the north side of Lake Prior in the center of Woonsocket, across the street from the lake's pool, swimming area and walking path. The city lists camping spots with electrical outlets, water and sewer here and east of the lake across the railroad tracks, but posts no rate, season or booking procedure: call the city office at (605) 796-4112 to confirm. --Claude
summary: City page confirms camping spots with electric outlets, water and sewer on the north side of Lake Prior (and a second area east of the lake across the tracks) but posts no rate, season or booking. Cleared aggregator-only fees (free-$15) and toilets/showers; note rewritten as call-first with the city office phone. Pin fine (~55 m). Waterfront stays not waterfront.
